translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from source extraction and all twenty PDF page images. No prior English translation or translation service used. Edition glossary and primary dictionaries consulted; interpretation and uncertainties recorded per source ID. No independent specialist review.

notes.manas-2010:p1481:b001:l001: Continues troops approaching from1480:40–42; named heroes establish flanks, without inventing a new battle location.
notes.manas-2010:p1481:b001:l005: Ninety mountains and impassable-to-wild-ass terrain are epic descriptions, not a mapped route.
notes.manas-2010:p1481:b001:l020: Боз чамбыл gray mass/cloud provisionally describes the separated gray-horse formation. Exact visual nuance remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1481:b001:l031: Канжаркол Dagger-Hands, a warrior category whose hand-training is explained1489:26–36. Not ordinary dagger-bearing infantry; singular exemplar sometimes uses the same designation as a name.
notes.manas-2010:p1481:b001:l033: Мыкаачы butchers in stated human-devouring hyperbole32, not an occupational job description.
notes.manas-2010:p1482:b001:l012: Лөк great bull-camel used metaphorically for Kongurbay’s supremacy; no separately mounted camel added.
notes.manas-2010:p1482:b001:l019: Кара көк fearless human epithet, Yudakhin көкIII https://el-sozduk.kg/көк/, established shared lexicon.
notes.manas-2010:p1482:b001:l028: First-person turn retained within Kongurbay’s speech, though governor is sent to duel29–31; not silently changed to his turn.
notes.manas-2010:p1482:b001:l029: Калдай governor, алп giant. Title is also used as individual designation, explicitly аттуу1497:30; distinction from later governors is not silently settled.
notes.manas-2010:p1482:b001:l038: Менде variant пенде servant/creature of God, conventional religious epithet.
notes.manas-2010:p1483:b001:l015: Эгиз paired/twin-like heroes not biological twin assertion; their named relationships differ elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p1483:b001:l018: Ырчы уулу translated Singer Son as transparent designation; Yraman retained as father’s name.
notes.manas-2010:p1483:b001:l031: Horse as companion to life is the contextual reading; not a second spare horse supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1483:b001:l037: Praise37–41 plausibly shifts to the governor, the Chinese defender, before he too charges42; no name inserted into ambiguous subject.
notes.manas-2010:p1484:b001:l001: Күн here thundering weather/heavens, not literal solar noise; source cosmic image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1484:b001:l019: Explicit conjectural Калгандарын→Калкандарын shields, supported parrying18 and axe-combat context. Raw unchanged, no independent witness or manuscript collation; alternative literal remains unfit in this equipment clause.
notes.manas-2010:p1484:b001:l028: No clothing left retained as exaggeration of grappling, not silently limited to outer layers.
notes.manas-2010:p1484:b001:l034: Sacred mane is horse’s mane, across which the opponent is tipped; exact horse ownership unmarked.
notes.manas-2010:p1484:b001:l038: Intent speech follows Kongurbay’s anger but precedes Zhöökülük’s action41; speaker/agent transition qualified, no invented direct order.
notes.manas-2010:p1485:b001:l001: Reached Baychoro retained despite7 saying Syrgak prevented reaching him; no narrative contradiction silently repaired.
notes.manas-2010:p1485:b001:l002: Black felt hat’s brim is affectionate Syrgak epithet, not an introduced Karakalpak identity.
notes.manas-2010:p1485:b001:l017: Улак goat-carcass dragging image retained; no new goat brought into the fight.
notes.manas-2010:p1485:b001:l018: Arkesken is the named sword, not a second combatant.
notes.manas-2010:p1485:b001:l024: Both deaths explicit: Zhöökülük and the dueling governor. Later giant-governor appearance1496 not harmonized into resurrection or another named identity.
notes.manas-2010:p1485:b001:l026: Seven thousand governors retained as epic numeric claim, separate from countless finest on28.
notes.manas-2010:p1485:b001:l042: Ырапыс ribbed rep cloth per established lexicon; not armor metal.
notes.manas-2010:p1486:b001:l001: Көк ала identified with Chubak’s recurrent named horse Kögala, explicitly1495:31; not a new unnamed piebald.
notes.manas-2010:p1486:b001:l002: Khan Baltay printed form retained beside Akbaltay elsewhere; no invented second father.
notes.manas-2010:p1486:b001:l008: Fury’s subject compressed; provisionally enemy army in following10–11, without claiming certainty.
notes.manas-2010:p1486:b001:l012: Уй куймулчак cowlike lean haunches, exact racehorse description in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/куймулчак/. Not cow tail.
notes.manas-2010:p1486:b001:l016: Karykan’s weather-stones explicitly possessed in Almambet’s pouch; no unprinted theft narrative added.
notes.manas-2010:p1486:b001:l024: Weather spells and summer-to-winter transformation34 retained as supernatural epic action, not a physical explanation.
notes.manas-2010:p1486:b001:l036: Making men whimper like girls is narrator’s gendered taunt; not literal bodily transformation.
notes.manas-2010:p1487:b001:l035: Thousand replacing thousand retains numerical repetition, without estimating troop totals.
notes.manas-2010:p1487:b001:l038: Grass twisted up into sky retained with upheaval imagery; exact cause not scientifically inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1488:b001:l011: Gouged eyes belong among described casualties; not every surviving fighter rendered blind.
notes.manas-2010:p1488:b001:l013: Dead swallowing blood retains graphic narrative image, not renewed living action.
notes.manas-2010:p1488:b001:l019: Mouths contextually horses following18; pit-like comparison retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1488:b001:l036: Never knows death is Chubak’s fearless-combat praise, not literal immortality claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1489:b001:l020: Dagger-Hand singular exemplar here contrasts plural category1495:41/1498:29; translation preserves both grammatical uses.
notes.manas-2010:p1489:b001:l029: Shift from one six-year-old to plural children preserved. Training is reciter’s description, not verified historical practice.
notes.manas-2010:p1489:b001:l032: Hundred days striking flour, hundred days sand33 retained exactly without added technique.
notes.manas-2010:p1489:b001:l038: Six thousand attacking kept distinct from preceding command for ten thousand21.
notes.manas-2010:p1490:b001:l009: Кесик lingering/incurable illness,2015 dictionary senseII cites Karalaev Semetey https://el-sozduk.kg/кесик/. Generic lingering sickness, not a diagnosed epidemic or a wound-only reading.
notes.manas-2010:p1490:b001:l019: Кымынча minute amount/whit read with half-penny comparison20; no silently supplied specific animal.
notes.manas-2010:p1490:b001:l031: Suspended/bound Buddha image retained as printed; precise cult arrangement uncertain, not converted into an actual human execution.
notes.manas-2010:p1490:b001:l035: Oath to death and age bounds17/55 belong to narrated mobilization, not modern instructions.
notes.manas-2010:p1491:b001:l004: Зубун detachment, exact Yudakhin зубун-зубун бөлүнүп https://el-sozduk.kg/зубун/ and edition glossary1838:5; lineage distinction remains separately on6–7.
notes.manas-2010:p1491:b001:l011: Жетелек provisionally still arriving/not yet arrived reinforcements; түмөн multitude in context, not an invented exact number.
notes.manas-2010:p1491:b001:l025: World-frightening clause kept at25, absent mountain-Manas at26, preserving source-ID alignment.
notes.manas-2010:p1491:b001:l032: Мыйзамдын гүлү autumn gossamer, exact Yudakhin paired quotation with preceding куурай https://el-sozduk.kg/мыйзам/. Edition glossary1841:16–17 mentions autumn-flowering grass and season but is textually brief; not law’s flower.
notes.manas-2010:p1491:b001:l034: Horses lose blood retained, despite more natural lose flesh; raw кан not emended.
notes.manas-2010:p1491:b001:l040: Forty cubits and forty years41 are Kongurbay’s threatened punishment, not actions already completed.
notes.manas-2010:p1492:b001:l004: Mecca explicitly named in threat of dispersal; no actual arrival there asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1492:b001:l007: Taking girls, blinding rebels and tribute demands remain the character’s proposals, not events silently enacted.
notes.manas-2010:p1492:b001:l024: Death before appointed death preserves ажалсыз өлүм paradox; not normalized away.
notes.manas-2010:p1493:b001:l002: Third-person lament narration resumes after previous page; English quotation closed at1492:42 for readability, not a source punctuation emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p1493:b001:l007: Not withdrawing what was extended retained with unexpressed object; likely weapon/body resolve, but no specific limb or oath invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1493:b001:l008: Visible жөлөгөн resting/leaning retained; not silently changed to negative sheathing formula.
notes.manas-2010:p1493:b001:l018: Courage-giving darling predicate remains aligned18, grieving troops17.
notes.manas-2010:p1493:b001:l039: Compressed quotation about departing retained before absent-Manas clause40. Exact logical attachment remains uncertain; no invented return promise.
notes.manas-2010:p1494:b001:l008: Blood against blood retained, not automatically khan against khan in the immediate bloodshed context.
notes.manas-2010:p1494:b001:l019: Shot-proof armor torn retained without inventing a specific penetration mechanism.
notes.manas-2010:p1494:b001:l024: Өң баатыр provisionally genuine/true heroes; no new troop rank inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1494:b001:l033: Көйкашка outstanding/finest men, matching individual epithet1495:2; not blaze-faced horses here.
notes.manas-2010:p1495:b001:l005: Syrgak’s explicit age21 retained; no harmonization with prior chronological notices.
notes.manas-2010:p1495:b001:l010: Кара көк fearless human epithet, established Yudakhin sense as1482:19.
notes.manas-2010:p1495:b001:l019: Eyeball-splitting marksmen is skill hyperbole; arrows explicit22/24, not guns supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1495:b001:l034: Түтөгөн provisionally springing up/flourishing anew parallel growing stronger35; no unrelated smoke image imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p1496:b001:l003: Subject resumes Chubak in combat, explicit Kögala6 and lion8; not Kongurbay riding Kögala.
notes.manas-2010:p1496:b001:l015: Giant governor reappears after1485 death. A title applies to many men in surrounding text; exact identity not independently resolved.
notes.manas-2010:p1496:b001:l027: Dislodged from saddle and stirrup does not by itself assert completed fall; he sways34 and is rescued next page.
notes.manas-2010:p1497:b001:l003: Teeth crumbling like millet retained as extraordinary rage image, not silently reduced to clattering.
notes.manas-2010:p1497:b001:l005: Мөндү Come, exact edition glossary1841:4–6 Kalmyk word used as battle cry; both repetitions translated.
notes.manas-2010:p1497:b001:l009: Урчу теңир урат deity-striking clause rendered literally; exact idiomatic force remains qualified, not a named Urchu god.
notes.manas-2010:p1497:b001:l030: Калдай аттуу expressly called Governor, treating title as individual designation while not resolving whether same as1485.
notes.manas-2010:p1497:b001:l038: Жая балбан champion on foot in context; whether Жая is an individual name remains uncertain. No unsupported new name adopted.
notes.manas-2010:p1497:b001:l042: Muzburchak explicitly decapitates governor after Syrgak unhorses him; both actors retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1498:b001:l006: Three champions knocked down together; subsequent rescue proves not all dead. Кыйратып rendered smashed, not declared killed.
notes.manas-2010:p1498:b001:l016: Көз айнек spectacles retained literally; no historical artifact dating inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1498:b001:l019: Thought subject shifts contextually to Chubak, named21; no claim that Kongurbay seeks his own death.
notes.manas-2010:p1498:b001:l026: Handfuls of blood are Chubak’s vengeful wish, not an action fulfilled; rescue interrupts.
notes.manas-2010:p1498:b001:l030: Көздөгөнү watching/targeting him read as rescue intention, exact referent qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1499:b001:l002: Шибээ retained as ethnonym Shibee, distinct from governor title; no modern ethnic equivalence forced.
notes.manas-2010:p1499:b001:l011: Right knee explicit rescue support, not silently replaced with saddle.
notes.manas-2010:p1499:b001:l026: Chinese rejoicing relates to Kökchö’s capture in following27–33, not celebration of Muzburchak’s rescue.
notes.manas-2010:p1499:b001:l029: Коок camel-hide headgear, exact edition glossary1839:22. Not the ordinary gourd sense; no unprinted torture method added.
notes.manas-2010:p1499:b001:l030: Backward mounting is explicit captive humiliation, not an accidental direction normalized away.
notes.manas-2010:p1500:b001:l015: Revived deadened life is rescue praise after captivity, not an independently narrated resurrection.
notes.manas-2010:p1500:b001:l024: Fierce-maned Fierce One preserves both көк жал and Калча epithets of Kongurbay; no second person.
notes.manas-2010:p1500:b001:l030: Bent wing means lost mount in following31, not anatomical human wings.
notes.manas-2010:p1500:b001:l039: Taillessness/wild-ass comparison retained despite zoological awkwardness; no alternative animal silently substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p1500:b001:l042: Bokmurun says father died when he was12; lament continues1501, no false ending at batch boundary.
